stem.text: To produce a stationary wave, two waves must travel in opposite directions through the same space.
Which statement about the properties of the two waves **must** also be correct?

A.text: The waves must have equal frequencies, but different speeds and wavelengths.

B.text: The waves must have equal speeds, but different wavelengths and frequencies.

C.text: The waves must have equal speeds, frequencies and wavelengths.

D.text: The waves must have equal wavelengths, but different speeds and frequencies.
